blocks.input_text:
[請求項1]
水面下で軸線が前後方向に延びるように配置され、前側を上流側とするとともに後側を下流側とする流路を形成する筒部と、
前記筒部の内部に配置され、前記軸線方向に延びる軸部と、
前記軸部に装着され、前記流路内で前記軸線の径方向に延びるとともに前記軸線の周方向に配列された複数のプロペラ翼を有し、前記軸線回りに回転可能なプロペラと、
前記流路内で前記プロペラに対して前側及び後側の少なくともいずれか一方に設けられ、前記径方向に延びるとともに前記周方向に配列され、前記軸部を支持する複数のストラットと、
を備え、
前記複数のストラットは、上下方向に延びて前記軸線を通る対称線に対して左右対称に配置され、
前記ストラット同士の角度間隔のうち少なくとも１つの角度間隔は、他の前記ストラット同士の角度間隔と異なり、
前記軸線を通るように水平方向に延在する水平面に対して、上下方向両側に少なくとも１つの前記ストラットが配置されている、推進装置。
blocks.output_text:
[Claim 1]
Propulsion device, wherein (a) a tubular portion which is disposed under a water surface so that an axis thereof extends in a front-rear direction and forms a flow path in which a front side is an upstream side and a rear side is a downstream side, a shaft portion which is disposed inside the tubular portion and extends in the axial direction, and a plurality of propeller blades which are mounted on the shaft portion and extend in a radial direction of the axis in the flow path and are arranged in a circumferential direction of the axis, a propeller that is rotatable about the axis, and a plurality of struts that are provided on at least one of a front side and a rear side with respect to the propeller in the flow path, extend in the radial direction, are arranged in the circumferential direction, and support the shaft portion, the plurality of struts are arranged symmetrically with respect to a line of symmetry extending in the vertical direction and passing through the axis, and at least one of the angular intervals between the struts is different from the angular intervals between the other struts, and at least one of the struts is arranged on both sides in the vertical direction with respect to a horizontal plane extending in the horizontal direction so as to pass through the axis.
